newsitem.title: USA: Covol says AJG to convert loan.
newsitem.headline: Covol says AJG to convert loan.

text.p: Covol Technologies said Friday AJG Financial Services Inc, a division of Arthur J Gallagher & Co, has chosen to convert its $1.1 million loan with Covol into Covol common stock.
Covol said the conversion price was at the market price of $8.00 per share.

Covol said the debenture was originally entered into as a separate transaction concurrent with the transaction between it and AJG for the sale of the Utah Synfuel No. 1, Covol's first synthetic fuel processing plant, into a partnership in which AJG has a significant interest.
The plant converts coal fines (small particles of coal 1/4" or smaller) into solid synthetic fuel.
